name: simple_cantilever_single_tube
geometry_source: Synthetic straight single tube; constant OD and wall thickness; no rear spar
boundary_condition_summary: Fixed root; no wire; no rear link
internal_model_target: Equivalent-beam path using SpatialBeamFEM or a tiny benchmark helper built from current section/FEM utilities
external_solver_target: ANSYS BEAM188 or CalculiX beam-element deck
expected_secondary_quantities: root reaction; beam mass; optional tip slope
purpose: Verify EI, units, mass, and fixed-root load integration before any dual-beam comparison
risk_isolated: Section-property math; unit conversion; BC definition; nodal load discretization
notes: Must match closed-form cantilever trend before moving on

name: tapered_single_tube
geometry_source: Synthetic straight single tube; tapered OD and or wall thickness along span
boundary_condition_summary: Fixed root; no wire; no rear link
internal_model_target: Equivalent-beam path with the same segment mapping and taper interpolation used by the repo
external_solver_target: ANSYS BEAM188 or CalculiX beam-element deck
expected_secondary_quantities: root reaction; beam mass; sensitivity to taper mapping
purpose: Verify spanwise EI integration and segment-to-element interpolation
risk_isolated: Taper interpolation; midpoint sampling; span discretization; half-span bookkeeping
notes: Benchmark 2 only makes sense after Benchmark 1 passes

name: dual_beam_without_wire
geometry_source: Synthetic front spar + rear spar with fixed spar separation and rigid rib links
load_source: Distributed vertical lift only on the main spar; no wire; no Cm torque
boundary_condition_summary: Fixed root on both spars; joint links only; no wire support
internal_model_target: dual_spar_ansys_parity as the primary internal target; optional production-no-Cm sensitivity sidecar
external_solver_target: ANSYS two-beam BEAM188 deck or CalculiX beam-element deck with explicit front/rear beams and rigid links
expected_secondary_quantities: max |UZ| location; support reaction; beam mass
purpose: Isolate front/rear load sharing and link-topology effects without wire or torque
risk_isolated: Parallel-axis equivalent vs explicit two-beam mismatch; link kinematics; rear amplification onset
notes: Use this to separate two-beam effects from wire and torque effects

name: dual_beam_with_wire
geometry_source: Same synthetic geometry as B3 plus one defined wire attachment and anchor geometry
load_source: Distributed vertical lift only; optional pretensioned wire support
boundary_condition_summary: Fixed root on both spars; wire support active; rigid links retained
internal_model_target: dual_beam_production with wire enabled; optional parity-style vertical-support fallback for diagnosis
external_solver_target: Beam-element deck with explicit cable or truss support if solver supports it; otherwise a documented support surrogate
expected_secondary_quantities: support reaction partition; main/rear tip ratio; wire tension or slack status
purpose: Isolate wire stiffness, pretension, tension-only behavior, and support mapping
risk_isolated: Wire unstretched length; pretension; tension-only activation; support-node contract
notes: If external solver cannot do tension-only cable, document the surrogate and do not call it final calibration

name: dual_beam_with_lift_and_cm_torque
load_source: Distributed lift plus aerodynamic torque; run three ownership variants
boundary_condition_summary: Fixed root on both spars; wire active; same geometry across A B C
internal_model_target: dual_beam_production plus explicit A/B/C torque-ownership reruns
external_solver_target: Beam-element ANSYS or CalculiX deck with both point-moment and force-couple variants
expected_secondary_quantities: main/rear tip deflection; support reaction partition; residual by axis; link hotspot pattern
purpose: Isolate torque ownership, sign convention, and moment-arm mapping before any production calibration factor is proposed
risk_isolated: Torque reference definition; sign convention; MY vs FZ-couple export path; half-span/full-span normalization
notes: Do not skip B5: current repo evidence says torque ownership is still an active risk

name: smooth_tier2_production_local_case
geometry_source: Freeze one current smooth_tier2 production-baseline candidate near the intended 6-7 deg operating band after case-freeze review
load_source: Use the actual spanwise load contract available for the frozen case; prefer spar_data.csv when frozen
boundary_condition_summary: Use the same root, wire, and load ownership contract that the frozen internal case uses
internal_model_target: Frozen dual_beam_production inverse-design or structural rerun case
external_solver_target: External beam benchmark first; shell-plus-beam CalculiX spot-check second
expected_secondary_quantities: support reaction; main/rear tip ratio; jig clearance and mass context
purpose: Bridge from controlled synthetic benchmarks to one real production-like case without jumping straight into full optimization
risk_isolated: Real load replay; geometry export quality; support completeness; mass bookkeeping in a realistic case
notes: Do not choose B6 until the lower-rung benchmark contract is stable
